newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Barrett raised, Belden cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Barrett raised, Belden cut.

text.p: -- First Albany said it raised its rating of Barrett Resources Corp to strong buy from buy and lowered its rating of Belden & Blake Corp to underperform from neutral.
-- Analyst Mike Smolinski said he had cut Belden to underperform because he expects the company's planned merger with Texas Pacific Group to close at the agreed upon price of $27 a share.
-- Smolinski called the recent fall in Barrett Resources' stock price "a blow-off overreaction to estimate reductions in a nervous stock market", making the stock "extremely attractive."
